stage: named immutable TZif snapshots, aggregate quota and explicit anchored-root reload
implementation: Exact case-sensitive bounded ASCII path names; caller-owned explicit manifest and visible version. No system TZ, implicit directory, data download, worker, watcher or shared runtime.

Cold copy/validate/heapsort/decode outside publication mutex. Bounded builders, expected-revision check before and at atomic publication. Failed/stale/closed candidates roll back without changing outputs/current version.
Immutable refcounted snapshots and independently retained zones survive reload, close and physical manager destruction. Existing jobs retain original zones until explicit replacement.

One Core quota charges manager, all generations/decoded footer/history and temporary IO/helper allocations until physically freed, including independently retained zones. Builder count and requested bytes are bounded.
Optional root loader opens contained names with public Core anchored APIs, validates regular <=16MiB files, full read/EOF and second metadata, closes every file and frees partial work on failure.

Close rejects future acquisition/build publication. Destroy requires Close, zero admitted builders and caller physical exclusion/join of ALL concurrent database calls. Loading0 does not imply a returned caller.
costs_and_limits: Find: validated bounded name, binary search and one retained zone result; normal success/NONE requests no allocation, IO or publication mutex. Acquire adds mutex and snapshot refcount.

Cold descriptor/name copies, in-place heapsort row moves, independent TZif/footer decoding and old-catalog release remain; aliases decode separately. File loading adds per-member resolve/open/read/stat/close and one temporary input buffer.

Quota excludes one fixed Core quota-control allocation, native mutex, allocator backing/headers, caller root/inputs and final outward diagnostic. Lower-level diagnostics within a load DO consume quota. Explicit inner quota replaces ambient caller quota per Core semantics.

Trusted immutable release directory/manifest is caller responsibility. Atomic publication does not provide a filesystem-wide transaction, release authentication or detection of every same-size concurrent rewrite.
Outputs must be disjoint from all other borrowed/retained owners; Find checks snapshot and selected zone rather than O(names) alias scans.
verification: 23 actual modular/single programs per platform; two offline runnable examples; six link-wrapped IO faults; static/shared consumers invoke all11 operations and retain owners after destruction.

286 quota boundaries across8 actual DST/footer/history entries, complete rollback and peak accounting. All footer/history positions plus arena failures exercised. Typed malformed data survives inner and outward diagnostic OOM.

Reverse257-name catalog,10000 positive and10000 negative lookups under one-byte quota with unchanged allocation counters; exact case/missing names, structural/mutual/nested aliases, invalid spans/counts, refcount/revision saturation.

Held source construction permits readers while builder is outside publication lock; builder admission, Close/Destroy busy, physical join rollback. Two held CAS builders race with one winner. Four readers through250 real publications validate coherent versions and detached zone lifetimes.
One422-zone2026e database per OS,54173 independent state/offset/name queries after source/root/manager destruction, including465 unknowns and1 missing name; snapshot owned requested bytes809072.

3798 actual named RootLoad/Acquire/Find calls per OS, then63180 actual public cursor Next and218700 legacy Match calls after root/snapshot/manager destruction;680 typed coverage errors (347 Next,333 Match). These are not all database lookups.

WSL O2 ASan/UBSan/leak-halt and two O1 TSan modular/single units pass. Windows85 tooling tests and generated feature/single/reference/docs checks pass. On resume13 performance-tool tests plus docs/single checks pass on final benchmark metrics.

Direct/generated declarations match config16,entry32,issue48,info40,stats64 on both x64 systems. Private manager Windows80/WSL152, snapshot header56,row32. Existing service config136/stats384 remain unchanged.
